title: Consolidate regional affinity cache and implement staged fallback executor
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: The smart router currently keeps multiple regional affinity caches and a legacy policy-engine-v1 adapter. This leads to redundant cache population, high memory churn during hot scales, and brittle fallback sequencing. Goal: Replace disparate caches with a sharded Affinity Layer that exposes a compact shard selector (bloom-filter backed) and a lightweight policy adapter. Also replace the monolithic fallback path with a Staged Fallback Executor that applies progressive fallback tiers with backoff and circuit-awareness.

Proposed changes: Consolidate per-region caches into a sharded affinity cache with compaction and TTL buckets, implement bloom-filter shard selector to reduce cross-shard probes, extract policy adapter behind a minimal interface so new policy engine (v2) can be hot-swapped, and implement Staged Fallback Executor that executes fallback tiers: local-shard -> regional-preferred -> regional-any -> cross-region-fallback. Add instrumentation hooks for per-stage latency and hit/miss counters.

Tradeoffs and constraints: Bloom filters reduce probes but add small false-positive rate; set tunable false-positive target to 1%. Sharded cache reduces memory but requires careful eviction coordination to keep warm-up costs low. Staged executor increases decision steps (small CPU cost) but reduces expensive full cross-region failovers. We prioritize P95 latency SLO and bounded CPU in hot paths.

Migration plan: 1) Implement affinity layer behind feature flag; 2) Introduce read-through mode that mirrors writes to new cache; 3) Canary selector for 5% traffic with staged fallback offload; 4) Expand to 25% then full cutover if metrics stable. Rollback path: disable feature flag and route through adapter to legacy caches.

Testing and telemetry: Unit tests for selector heuristics and fallback ordering; integration test harness that replays production sampling traces; load tests for warmup and compaction. Dashboard panels to add: shard-hit-rate, staged-fallback-latency (per-stage p50/p95), warmup-duration, and eviction-rate. Alert on staged-fallback p95 regressions > 10% vs baseline.

Acceptance criteria: 1) 15% reduction in routing p95 under representative workload, 2) no more than 2% error increase during canary, 3) telemetry present for all fallback stages and cache compaction events.

Notes: This ticket focuses on infra refactor and safe migration. Policy logic improvements are out-of-scope; we provide a stable adapter for policy-engine-v2 to plug into after cutover.
